hunted_j16: On Day 3 Henrik Hunted took a post at R-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He collects shell fuses, and the men liked him for it.
miguell.jacob: The new runner is Otto "Ash" Jacob, once a coal miner from Millbank. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Otto "Ash" Jacob said he would find out.
Volunteer number 41. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Otto "Ash" Jacob's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Otto "Ash" Jacob began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F14 with the rations. Otto "Ash" Jacob ate while listening to the revised orders.
tom_ua_: In Belmonte, Anselm Tom was a railway porter. In S-F9, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.
Volunteer number 94. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Anselm Tom's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The transfer made Anselm Tom a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Edmund Somosmagios and Anselm Tom compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Anselm Tom thought about a younger sister who sends drawings on sentry tonight, and the cold felt a little further away.

Anselm Tom cut Matthias Mihai's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Verdel Ridge is lost. Anselm Tom heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
zgeorges11: Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges arrived on Day 3 as a replacement. The men in R-F18 had been fighting for 2 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Verdel Ridge is lost. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
